title: Hybrid Shadow-A/B Coordinator with Autoscale Failback and Deterministic Revert
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Introduces Hybrid Shadow-A/B Coordinator: enables coordinated shadow traffic seeding alongside A/B routing with autoscale-aware failback and a deterministic instant-revert path. Backwards compatible with existing rollout policies.
description: Background: customers running mixed canary + A/B experiments were seeing noisy autoscale events and prolonged partial promotions when a model variant caused transient resource pressure. This PR adds a coordinator that runs alongside the rollout runtime to: 1) orchestrate simultaneous shadow seeding for A/B arms so traffic can be safely validated off-path, 2) surface autoscale pressure signals to the rollout decision graph and trigger graceful failback windows, and 3) provide a deterministic, snapshot-backed revert that can be executed instantly if safety gates trip. Motivation: reduce time-to-rollout for multi-variant experiments while preventing cascade-induced promotions and providing reproducible rollback. Changes: - new service: rollout/hybrid_coordinator (golang) with a light state machine for shadow seeding and autoscale feedback. - API: A new RolloutPolicy extension (policy.type: hybrid-shadow-ab) and two new hooks: autoscale_metric and shadow_sample_rate. - Scheduler changes: minor patch to servegraph reconciler to add coordinator callbacks and to make promotes interruptible by external abort signals. - Telemetry: added coordinator.* metrics, trace spans for shadow seed lifecycle, and a diagnostic event for deterministic-reverts. Migration: existing RolloutPolicies are unchanged; the new policy is opt-in. Checklist: [x] unit tests for coordinator state transitions, [x] integration test with canary + A/B scenario in perf-lab, [x] API docs and schema additions, [x] observability dashboards updated, [x] smoke-run in staging. Notes: kept the runtime changes minimal; most logic is in the coordinator service to allow safe rollback without kernel-level changes. See linked Linear ENG-9876 for design doc and ENG-10234 for perf plan.
commit_summary: 3 commits: 1) rollout: add hybrid coordinator service and tests (golang) 2) api: extend RolloutPolicy schema + docs 3) reconcile: scheduler callbacks + telemetry and staging smoke-run tweaks
review_conversation: Elliot Moreno: Left an initial pass; concerned about edge-case where autoscale signal oscillates. Can we debounce and expose a backoff TTL?
Priya Shah: Added a debounce window (configurable via policy.autoscale_debounce_ms) and unit tests to verify oscillation logic. See commit 2.
Cara Liu: Request to ensure the deterministic revert uses an immutable snapshot reference (not a sliding window). Also asked for an explicit audit event on revert.
Priya Shah: Rework: coordinator now creates a snapshot manifest at seed start and the revert action references that manifest. Audit event added to telemetry and policy history log. See commit 3.
Diego Alvarez: Verified perf-lab results; suggested reducing default shadow_sample_rate for small models to reduce KV pressure. Accepted and lowered default to 0.02 in the schema.
Elliot Moreno: Approving now that debounce and snapshot fixes are in. +1 from SRE for staging smoke-run results.
CI: integration suite passed (rollout unit/integration/telemetry). Final e2e flaked once, retriggered, passed.
changed_areas_summary: Adds a coordinator microservice, API schema extensions, scheduler callback hooks, telemetry and dashboards, test scenarios and deployment manifests. No breaking changes to existing rollout policies; opt-in behavior via policy.type: hybrid-shadow-ab.
notes_for_ops: Staging rollout: enable feature gate rollout.hybrid_coordinator; watch coordinator.shadow_seed_latency and coordinator.autoscale_backpressure metrics. Revert playbook: use CLI 'redwood rollout revert --snapshot=<manifest-id>' which will be added to runbook; the PR includes example runbook entries in changelogs/2026-02-03-hybrid-shadow-ab.md.
security_review: security reviewed; noted container image uses minimal base image and non-root user. Minor hardening follow-up (secret rotation for snapshot store) filed as SUP-4421.
post_merge_tasks: 1) promote dashboard to prod, 2) run a controlled hybrid A/B experiment in dedicated staging with 10k requests/min for 6 hours, 3) roll out feature gate to 20% of accounts, monitor for 72 hours.
ci_checks: unit: pass, integration: pass, smoke: pass, lint: pass, e2e: pass
qa_notes: Integration test simulates autoscale + shadow traffic for two model arms; assertions included for no more than 10% increased p99 CPU during seed and deterministic revert confirmation. QA verified in perf-lab on 2026-01-28.
user_impact: Low-risk opt-in. Users see no change unless they opt into new policy. Adds faster rollback capability for experiments and reduces promotion noise during autoscale events.
